title: The Birth of a Son Vindicates the Khalsa Prayer

blocks.text: The Khalsa answer the challenge by having five Singhs make a joint prayer and by committing themselves in writing rather than relying on noise, threats, or miracle claims.
They promise that the family will receive a child within the stated time and ask that any one tenth share or other offering be delayed until the truth of the blessing becomes visible.
After the expiry of seven months the woman gave birth to a son, and the page treats that fulfilled promise as the public humiliation of the pretenders and the vindication of disciplined Sikh prayer.
